```python
import pandas as pd

long_df = pd.read_csv('gross_savings_long.csv')
# Keep only 2001-2010
period_df = long_df[(long_df['year'] >= 2001) & (long_df['year'] <= 2010)]
# Pivot to wide
wide = period_df.pivot_table(index=['country_id', 'country_name'], columns='year', values='value').reset_index()
# Ensure columns are strings for years
wide.columns = [str(c) if isinstance(c, int) else c for c in wide.columns]
wide.to_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010_wide.csv', index=False)
print(wide.head())
print('Rows:', len(wide), 'Columns:', len(wide.columns))
```

```python
import json
import pandas as pd
from urllib.request import urlopen

# Fetch country metadata
meta_url = 'https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country?format=json&per_page=400'
with urlopen(meta_url) as f:
    meta = json.loads(f.read().decode('utf-8'))
meta_records = meta[1]
meta_rows = []
for c in meta_records:
    meta_rows.append({
        'country_id': c['id'],
        'name_meta': c['name'],
        'region': c['region']['value'],
        'admin_region': c['adminregion']['value'],
        'income': c['incomeLevel']['value'],
        'lending': c['lendingType']['value']
    })
meta_df = pd.DataFrame(meta_rows)

wide = pd.read_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010_wide.csv')
merged = wide.merge(meta_df[['country_id','region']], on='country_id', how='left')
# Exclude aggregates
countries_df = merged[merged['region'] != 'Aggregates']

countries_df.to_csv('gross_savings_countries_2001_2010.csv', index=False)
print(countries_df.head())
print('Country rows:', len(countries_df))
```

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('gross_savings_countries_2001_2010.csv')
years = [str(y) for y in range(2001, 2011)]

shortlist = ["China", "Singapore", "Brunei Darussalam", "Qatar", "Malaysia", "Oman"]
sub = df[df['country_name'].isin(shortlist)].copy()

# Check >35 for every year and no missing
def qualifies(row):
    vals = row[years]
    return vals.notnull().all() and (vals > 35).all()

qualifiers = sub[sub.apply(qualifies, axis=1)]['country_name'].tolist()
print('Qualifiers in shortlist:', qualifiers)
```
